snippets.snippet_text: "Digital product, Course or tutorial, and E-book type products allow you to sell one-time payment products with digital content in it. You can also sell recurring charge memberships, physical goods that you ship, a bundle of multiple existing products, and service-type products. Products can be free or as much as USD 5,000. You can also let customers pay whatever they want by adding a '+' to a product's minimum price, like "$5+"."
